description: This file defines the `ScanResultAdapter` class, which is a custom adapter for displaying Bluetooth scan results in an Android ListView or similar component. It manages a collection of `ScanResult` objects, provides methods to add, clear, and retrieve data, and formats timestamps into human-readable relative time strings.

classes.name: ScanResultAdapter
classes.description: A custom adapter extending BaseAdapter to display Bluetooth LE scan results, managing a list of `ScanResult` objects and providing view generation and data updating functionalities.

methods.name: ScanResultAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with a context, layout inflater, and an empty list of scan results.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of scan results in the list.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the scan result at a specified position.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns a unique ID for the scan result, based on the device's address hash code.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses a view for a list item, populates it with device name, address, and last seen time.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Finds the list position of a device with a given address.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new `ScanResult` to the list or updates an existing entry for the same device.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all scan results from the adapter.

methods.name: getTimeSinceString
methods.description: Static method converting a nanosecond timestamp into a human-readable string indicating how long ago the scan result was seen.
